title.narrative: Sharing Knowledge for Inclusive Leadership and Livelihood Success by Engaging Youth in Climate Resilience, Biodiversity and Local Agri-Economies.

description.narrative: This Project target young people and their communities to be educated on the value of agro-ecology, local knowledge and inclusive leadership practices in enhancing natural eco-systems for health and wealth. While also being trained in appropriate forestry practices, climate action and smart agri-business methods for improved green employment growth, natural resource management and bio-diversity protection in Morobe Province.
